ES.name: Spain
ES.note: National holidays common to all of Spain. Check the yearly BOE resolution and the regional and municipal calendars.

FR.note: Jours fériés of the Code du travail. Only 1 May is a paid day off by law for every employee; others depend on the collective agreement. Whit Monday may be the journée de solidarité. Overseas departments add the abolition of slavery day; Alsace-Moselle (FR-57, FR-67, FR-68) adds Good Friday and 26 December.
